speakers.headline: Solution Architect @ Fabrick S.p.a.
speakers.biographyMd:
I am Alessandro Miliucci, a developer, author and speaker. Although I have many interests, software development is what I devote most of my time to and what I am best known for. I have also written a few books on software development.

My interests range over all aspects of software: from user interfaces to databases, including network protocols.

I am a co-organizer of RomaJS meetup and the leader of MongoDB User Group in Rome.

During my career I have spent a lot of time working on start-ups such as Hype, the first Italian neo-bank, and Vidra, an e-commerce SaaS that I co-Founded.
Nowadays I work as a Solution Architect for Fabrick S.p.a. one of the leading Italian Fintech companies.

speakers.headline: AI Engineer
speakers.biographyMd: Alessandro Riboni is a Staff Engineer at Generali, specializing in AI engineering and GenAI platforms. Supports internal teams and builds horizontal tooling that standardizes and simplifies GenAI development: from a framework for prompt management, automated evaluation and CI/CD-based release of prompts, to Flowmetrics, a semantic layer that gives AI agents governed access to business metrics. Before that, five years in consulting for insurance and banking: first as a data engineer on real-time pipelines, then as an ML engineer building LLM-based claims assistants, RAG systems for policy risk assessment and document-parsing tools on AWS. Holds an MSc in Data Science from the University of Milano-Bicocca.

speakers.headline: CTO, Founder, Software engineer at Omnes
speakers.biographyMd:
Alessio is CTO and Software Engineer at Omnes. Over the years, he has specialized in building tailored digital platforms, evolving from early work in C, C++, JAVA, PHP and Laravel to large-scale projects powered by modern stacks such as Vue.js, Nuxt, TypeScript, React and Node.js.

His technical journey has been shaped by constant curiosity for scalable architectures and performance-driven design. Alessio has worked extensively with cloud infrastructures on AWS, relational as well as NoSQL databases, real-time messaging, and modern headless frameworks.

Today he leads teams building B2B and B2C platforms that combine strong engineering foundations with a focus on user experience and accessibility, while exploring how AI and automation are reshaping development practices.

speakers.headline: Senior Staff Engineer @ Smartness, author of Queen MQ
speakers.biographyMd:
Alice Viola Setti is a proud neurodivergent transgender woman, software engineer, architect, and sysadmin with a master's degree in Mechatronic Engineering and a product-builder mindset.

Her background spans the entire technical spectrum, from provisioning bare-metal datacenters to architecting complex distributed systems and leading engineering teams. She is highly autonomous and drives end-to-end product delivery.

She works mainly with Kubernetes, Kafka, Postgres, C++, Node, and Vue, and has shipped with Python, Ruby, Objective-C++, Swift, Rust, OpenCV, Proxmox, VMware, Nginx, HAProxy, Scylla, Redis, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, OpenSearch, Solr, Neo4j, Cassandra, Pulsar, RabbitMQ, NATS, and MQTT.

She has installed and managed clusters in on-premise datacenters using bare-metal servers, hypervisors, and Kubernetes; configured network switches and firewalls; developed microservice architectures; built drone control systems; and conducted research in computer vision.

speakers.headline: Tech Lead & Team Lead @ Bitrock, Podcaster @ Shiftati di Testa

Nella sua carriera ha visto di tutto: da un’azienda di 5 persone al reparto IT di un ospedale, fino a una multinazionale da 20 mila dipendenti, senza farsi mancare il “classico” anno da freelance. Dal 2021 lavora nell'area front-end di Bitrock, una società di consulenza di Milano.
Fuori dall'ufficio calca i palchi come improvvisatore teatrale, e si spaccia per stand-up comedian con i Gin Comici. Insieme a Stefano conduce Shiftati di Testa: Il podcast più atteso del web (anche se il web ancora non lo sa!)

Il mio obiettivo è garantire che ogni sito web sia accessibile a tutti, indipendentemente dalle capacità fisiche o cognitive.

speakers.headline: AI engineer @ Gamindo
speakers.biographyMd:
Putting AI into production is not just about connecting a model to a chat interface. In Gamindo AI, we built a workflow that turns vague requirements, source materials and live game state into structured game-based learning content: it refines the initial intent, generates a validated learning experience, supports controlled edits through structured patches, and produces contextual commentary and audio aligned with gameplay.

This talk walks through the architecture behind it: typed contracts with PydanticAI, FastAPI endpoints, fallback strategies across OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, streaming events, output validation, eval datasets, custom evaluators, observability with Logfire, and practical error handling.

Attendees will leave with patterns and tradeoffs for designing AI workflows that are robust, observable, measurable and flexible enough to evolve without rewriting everything.

speakers.headline: Founder of The Fool

He hosts “Intelligenze Artifici” on Mediaset/TgCom and the tech policy YouTube channel “Ciao Internet”. A lecturer and keynote speaker, he is a three-time TEDx speaker and former Forbes podcaster.

As the founder of the AWS User Group Basilicata and co-founder of 'Come To Code'—the largest IT conference in Southern Italy—Maurizio is a driving force in the Italian tech ecosystem. He also leads GDG Basilicata and the PLUG (Pignola Linux User Group), where he has spent over 10 years promoting Open Source culture and digital literacy.
Maurizio’s mission is to prove that innovation knows no boundaries. He believes that real progress happens through human connection and is dedicated to fostering inclusive spaces where tech hubs can thrive anywhere—from major cities to small mountain villages.

speakers.headline: RuneHeads, CEO
speakers.biographyMd:
Moreno Lovato crea il suo primo videogioco a 14 anni programmando in assembler sul mitico Commodore 64.
Dopo quindici anni di esperienza nel campo dell’ITC come project manager e responsabile di sviluppo per i contesti bancari, automotive e editoria, torna al mondo dei videogames fondando una rivista online di settore. Successivamente decide di abbandonare la carriera da manager per dedicarsi a tempo pieno al mondo dei videogames.

Negli ultimi quindici anni ha lavorato su oltre venti titoli, alcuni con un successo internazionale e con oltre quindici milioni di giocatori. Alcuni dei maggiori titoli sono: Extreme Landings, Frecce Tricolori, Blue Angels, Conglomerate 451 e Journey to the Void.

Nel corso degli anni ha dedicato parte del suo tempo all’insegnamento dello sviluppo di videogiochi nelle principali scuole di game development in Italia (DBGA, Event Horizon, Naba, Accademia Santa Giulia, Fastweb Academy, AIV e altre). 

Oggi è alla guida dello studio indipendente RuneHeads.

speakers.headline: GDE Cloud • Google Cloud Architect • Google Cloud Authorized Trainer • Team Manager • GDG Community Lead 🚀

With over a decade of hands-on experience in Digital Transformation, I specialize in Google Cloud Platform, Generative AI (Vertex AI), and complex multi-cloud architectures. My philosophy is simple: an elite strategy is useless without an elite team to execute it, so I build the team first, knowing that the results will follow.
As a passionate advocate for open knowledge, I am a Google Cloud Authorized Trainer, a Google Developer Expert (GDE) for Cloud, and the Community Lead for GDG Campobasso.

speakers.headline: CTO at Wonderful - Forbes 30 Under 30 Europe, founder of Horus Technology

speakers.biographyMd:
🧑‍🚀 AI Engineer/explorer. Passionate about Language Models, open source, and knowledge sharing.

👨‍💻 I work on the open-source Haystack LLM orchestration framework, contributing code, tutorials and demos.

🧭 Fascinated by all things LLMs. From inference and orchestration (Agents, RAG) to post-training techniques. I frequently experiment with training small Language Models and Reinforcement Learning. I like sharing what I learn.

speakers.headline: Tech Sustainability Consultant, Speaker, Host @ Green Tech Tales
speakers.biographyMd: As a Green Software Advocate and Tech Sustainability Consultant, my mission is helping companies and professionals build more sustainable, low-carbon digital solutions. Since discovering technology's environmental impact in early 2023, I've become a recognized speaker at major tech conferences and co-founded Green Software Italia community. I believe in responsible technology that creates positive impact for both businesses and the environment.

speakers.headline: Data Scientist
speakers.biographyMd: Statistician by education, Valeria is a Data Scientist specializing in real-time models for complex, challenging scenarios. Driven by a deep curiosity for the latest research, she applies advanced analytical techniques to build intelligent systems that deliver immediate and effective solutions in high-impact domains.
